armies_of_renown.name: Ironsunz
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ironjawz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be an Ironsunz Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ironjawz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the IRONSUNZ keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
0-1 Dakkbad Grotkicker
Megaboss
Warchanter
Weirdnob Shaman
Brutes
Brute Ragerz
Weirdbrute Wrekkaz
0-1 Tyrant (Kagruk the Kin-eater)
0-1 Ogor Gluttons (Tarkan Ogors)
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
In addition to the above, for each unit of Brutes, Brute Ragerz or Weirdbrute Wrekkaz on your army roster, you can pick 1 of each of the following units:
Ardboy Big Boss
Ardboyz
Maw-grunta Gougers
Maw-grunta with Hakkin’ Krew
Gore-gruntas

battle_traits.name: 'Up and At 'Em!'
battle_traits.effect: When making run rolls for friendly IRONSUNZ units, if you roll a 1-2, you can use a value of 3 instead.

battle_traits.name: 'Let's Try Dis...'
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ INFANTRY unit wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Keep On Smashin'
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ unit that destroyed an enemy unit this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target can move 3". It can end that move in combat. If the enemy unit that was destroyed was a MONSTER, the target can move 6" instead of 3".

battle_traits.name: Ironsunz Waaagh!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ HERO to use this ability, then pick each friendly IRONSUNZ unit wholly within 18" of them to be the targets. Dakkbad Grotkicker must be picked to use this ability if he is on the battlefield.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Melee weapons used by the targets have Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)
• The targets cannot be picked as the target of RAMPAGE abilities.
• The targets can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn.

entries.name: Soulkrumpa
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• The target cannot be healed.
• Slain models cannot be returned to the target unit.

entries.name: Seen Dat Before
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target charged this turn. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target's weapons cannot be affected by weapon abilities other than the Companion weapon ability.

entries.name: Brutal Troof
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly IRONSUNZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks if it charged in the same turn or is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

entries.name: Animosity
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Mork's Melee Miracle
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly IRONSUNZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6, subtracting the current battle round number from the roll.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add the number of the current battle round to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

entries.name: Summon Foot of Gork
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Foot of Gork on the battlefield, pick a friendly IRONSUNZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Foot of Gork wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Foot of Gork has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

entries.name: Ghurish Beat
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of the target terrain feature. If the chanting roll was 9+, you can pick 2 eligible terrain features to be the targets instead of 1.

entries.name: Krumpin' Beat
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, inflict D3 damage on each enemy unit within 3" of the target.

entries.name: Ironsunz Beat
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRONSUNZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit whose Health characteristic is lower than the target's.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit whose Health characteristic is the same as or greater than the target's.
If the chanting roll was 10+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons instead.

armies_of_renown.name: Krazogg's Grunta Stampede
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ironjawz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Krazogg’s Grunta Stampede Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on this page instead of the Ironjawz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the GRUNTA STAMPEDE keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
Maw-grunta Gougers
Gore-gruntas
Maw-grunta with Hakkin’ Krew
Tuskboss on Maw-grunta

battle_traits.name: Incessant Drive
battle_traits.timing: End of the First Battle Round
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the momentum scores of friendly MAW-GRUNTA units.

battle_traits.name: Fast and Furious
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO GRUNTA STAMPEDE unit to be the target
battle_traits.effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase

battle_traits.name: Monstrous Momentum
battle_traits.effect: Add the current battle round number to the Move characteristic of friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE units.

battle_traits.name: Eatin' on da Hoof
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly Grunta Stampede Monster that has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice and add the momentum score of the unit using this ability to the roll. If the result exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

battle_traits.name: Wall of Hogflesh
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target that HERO while it is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-HERO GRUNTA STAMPEDE unit.

battle_traits.name: Grunta Waaagh!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:
• You can re-roll charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units' Maw-grunta's Trotters.
• Roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted by the 'Goregrunta Charge' ability of those units.

entries.name: Trophy Hunta
entries.effect: This unit's Pig-hakka has Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend) and Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend).

entries.name: Da Boom Skull
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a command for a friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE unit wholly within 18" of this unit
entries.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

armies_of_renown.name: Zoggrok's Ironmongerz
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ironjawz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Zoggrok’s Ironmongerz Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ironjawz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Zoggrok Anvilsmasha (must be included and must be your general)
IRONJAWZ INFANTRY HEROES
Non-HERO IRONJAWZ INFANTRY units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Legendary Vandals
battle_traits.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ units have Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend) and Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend).

battle_traits.name: Into Da Breach!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ unit that is more than 9" from any enemy units and had any damage points allocated to it this turn.
battle_traits.effect: That unit can move D6". It cannot pass through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat.

battle_traits.name: Ironclad Scrums
battle_traits.effect: Friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ Ardboyz units with 3 or more models have WARD (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of a different friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ Ardboyz unit with 3 or more models.

battle_traits.name: Shield of Scrap and Muscle
battle_traits.effect:
While a friendly Zoggrok Anvilsmasha is within the combat range of a friendly Ardboyz unit:
• That Zoggrok Anvilsmasha has WARD (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Zoggrok Anvilsmasha, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly Ardboyz unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.name: Oi! Back To It!
entries.effect: If a friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ Ardboyz or BRUTES unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

entries.name: Da Great Wollopa
entries.effect:
If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made by this unit, that enemy unit is krump'd until the start of your next turn.
While a unit is krump'd:
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

entries.name: The Green God's Hammer
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

entries.name: Get 'Em, Gork!
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 5-9, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 18" of the chanter instead. That terrain feature is trampled by Gork for the rest of the battle.
Roll a D3 each time an enemy unit ends a move within 6" of a terrain feature that is trampled by Gork. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy unit equal to the roll.

entries.name: Summon Gork-Roara
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Gork-Roara on the battlefield, pick a friendly ZOGGROK'S IRONMONGERZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Gork-Roara wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
